requirements.spec: The store exported by src/db.js must write through FileStore on save()
requirements.expected_artifact: src/db.js exports a store whose save() method is FileStore.save(), which writes to disk via fs.writeFileSync
requirements.evidence: FileStore.save() at line 13-17 reads the current file, pushes data, and calls fs.writeFileSync(this.path, JSON.stringify(rows)); module.exports exports new FileStore() at line 24

requirements.spec: The store exported by src/db.js must read through FileStore on load()
requirements.expected_artifact: src/db.js exports a store whose load() method is FileStore.load(), which reads from disk via fs.readFileSync
requirements.evidence: FileStore.load() at line 18-21 calls fs.readFileSync(this.path, 'utf8') and parses JSON; the exported store uses this method

requirements.spec: MemoryStore must no longer be used by the exported store
requirements.expected_artifact: module.exports in src/db.js must not use MemoryStore
requirements.evidence: line 24: module.exports = { store: new FileStore() }; MemoryStore class is defined but not exported or used by the exported store

requirements.spec: Requiring src/db.js yields a store that actually persists to data.json
requirements.expected_artifact: FileStore constructor defaults path to 'data.json' and save/load use that path
requirements.evidence: FileStore constructor: this.path = path || 'data.json'; no path argument passed in new FileStore() on line 24, so it defaults to 'data.json'; save writes to this.path and load reads from this.path
